_**Agent (grok-4.7)**_

The phone never reads the printed number. It only reads the QR, and the text inside that QR is the ID.

## What to put in the QR

Use plain text, not a URL. For the sticker marked `999`, the QR should contain exactly:

```text
FANTA:FP-00999
```

The app accepts that string only when it matches `FANTA:` followed by letters, digits, and hyphens. It then stores the part after the colon, uppercased, as the person’s code: `FP-00999`.

| Printed on the sticker | Text encoded in the QR | What the app stores |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `FP-00999` | `FANTA:FP-00999` | `FP-00999` |
| `FP-00482` | `FANTA:FP-00482` | `FP-00482` |

Print the same code in both places. `999` on the sticker and `FANTA:FP-00999` in the QR will still scan, but staff will not be able to match the tab to the code the app saved. Drop the `FANTA:` prefix from the printed type; that prefix is only for the QR.

Name and company are not in the QR. They stay handwritten. After a scan, the player types them in.

## How the app uses it

There is no lookup table and no server check of the number. The QR text is the identity.

- A new code becomes a new contact and scores points.
- The same code scanned again is the same person and scores nothing.
- Two stickers with the same QR are the same person, even if the handwriting differs.

## How to make the QR for the size test

Any QR generator in text mode works (the printer’s variable-data tool, Illustrator, or a site such as qr-code-generator.com). Settings that matter for a phone photo:

- Content: `FANTA:FP-00999` and nothing else.
- Error correction: Q or H.
- Black modules on white, with a quiet zone of at least four modules. Do not place it on the orange or the blue.
- Keep it inside the camera frame. About 18 mm on the long side is the target; your smaller sizes are the test.

Use that same payload on every size. A successful scan then tells you the size works, not that the content changed.

_**Agent (grok-4.7)**_

Use **QR Code Monkey**: [qrcode-monkey.com](https://www.qrcode-monkey.com/). It makes a static code, lets you set the error correction, and downloads an SVG you can scale on the sticker without it going soft.

Set it up like this:

1. Open the site and choose **Text**. Do not choose URL. A URL code will not scan in the app.
2. Paste `FANTA:FP-00999` (change the digits for each sticker).
3. Leave the logo off. Keep the code black (`#000000`) on white (`#ffffff`).
4. Set error correction to **Q**. Use **H** only on the smallest test sizes.
5. Download **SVG** and place it on the white part of the sticker, with white space around it.

Check the result with your phone’s camera before you print. The preview should show the text `FANTA:FP-00999`, not a website.
